svg.title: A nurse is providing information about hospice services to the family of a client who has a terminal illness. Which information should the nurse include? (Select all that apply.)
svg.desc: Hospice is COMFORT-FOCUSED care for a client with a prognosis of about 6 MONTHS OR LESS, delivered by an INTERDISCIPLINARY TEAM, most often IN THE CLIENT'S HOME rather than a hospital. Curative therapy for the terminal illness stops, but aggressive SYMPTOM MANAGEMENT continues, and BEREAVEMENT SUPPORT FOR THE FAMILY CONTINUES AFTER THE DEATH, typically for about 13 months.
